REST API for the Kestra open source workflow orchestration platform. Covers
flow definitions, executions, namespaces, triggers, key-value store, and
namespace files. Documented at https://kestra.io/docs/api-reference/open-source.
The Kestra server defaults to basic authentication and exposes the API under
the `/api/v1/` prefix on the configured host.
